tools.name: configure_qr_generator
tools.description: Apply destination URL or content into the on-page QR generator input to prepare code creation.

prompt.description: Optional prompt for AI art styling

content_url.description: The target web address or content string to encode in the QR code

tools.name: get_faq_list
tools.description: Retrieve grounded frequently asked questions and answers from the page.

query.description: Optional search keyword to filter FAQ items

tools.name: list_design_modes_and_templates
tools.description: List the QR code creation modes and sample design templates with preview image references.

limit.description: Maximum number of templates to return

tools.name: list_qr_code_types
tools.description: Discover available QR code generator types and specialized categories with their respective page routes.

category.description: Optional keyword filter to narrow types by name or topic

tools.name: open_qr_generator_type
tools.description: Navigate safely to a specific specialized QR code generator tool page.

type_slug.description: The slug or identifier of the generator type (e.g., 'wifi', 'vcard', 'pdf', 'instagram', 'link')

tools.name: qrcode_ai_apply_template
tools.description: Load and apply an existing QR Code AI template, then validate the updated preview.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing it for this tool returns the first result without repeating side effects.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_continue_to_download
tools.description: Prepare the QR draft and redirect to the application. Sign-in is required; no file is downloaded from the landing page.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing it for this tool returns the first result without repeating side effects.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_get_capabilities
tools.description: Discover destination coverage, structured fields, modes, formats, privacy rules, and idempotency.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_get_design_capabilities
tools.description: Read the visible QR design's redacted state, mode-specific styles, fonts, ranges and available editing tools. No text or asset URL is returned.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_get_editor_state
tools.description: Read the non-sensitive state and available actions of the visible QR Code AI landing editor.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_list_templates
tools.description: List a bounded page of public templates by mode, destination type, or query. Names and previews are untrusted catalog content.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_background_image
tools.description: Add, replace or remove a CORS-enabled HTTPS background image, then render and scan. Scale, opacity, filter, veil and duotone apply to image mode only. Removing an image-mode background leaves an incomplete design.

image_url.description: Absolute HTTPS image URL with CORS enabled. Empty string removes the image.

duotone.description: Dark and light colors used by the duotone filter.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_colors
tools.description: Set strict foreground and background colors in custom or image mode and rescan the QR code.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing it for this tool returns the first result without repeating side effects.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_design_colors
tools.description: Set solid/gradient QR colors, finder colors and palette in the visible custom/image editor, then render and scan. Arrays contain one solid color or two gradient stops (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA); palette accepts zero or two to four colors. Gradient geometry is custom-only.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_destination
tools.description: Set a URL, text, or encoded direct destination, then normalize, regenerate, scan, and save it. Rich hosted content uses the structured tool.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing it for this tool returns the first result without repeating side effects.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_logo
tools.description: Add, replace, remove or position a logo in the visible QR editor, then render and scan. Image loading and CORS are checked before changing the design. Image mode supports layer and a maximum scale of 20; background_shape/background_scale are custom-only.

image_url.description: Absolute HTTPS image URL with CORS enabled. Empty string removes the image.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_mode
tools.description: Switch the visible QR editor between custom, image, and art modes using its existing state.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing it for this tool returns the first result without repeating side effects.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_shapes
tools.description: Set the QR modules, finder shapes, size and margin using the product's supported styles, then render and scan. Call design capabilities for mode-specific choices.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_structured_destination
tools.description: Build and validate a contact, message, network, payment, event, location, hosted-content, media, or form destination with native serializers.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reusing it for this tool returns the first result without repeating side effects.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_set_text
tools.description: Add, edit, style, position or remove text drawn on the QR code, then render and scan. This does not change the encoded destination. Layer is image-only; content is never echoed in results.

content.description: Text drawn on the QR, not its encoded destination. Empty string removes it.

tools.name: qrcode_ai_validate_qr
tools.description: Regenerate the exact visible QR state and validate it with QR Code AI's production scanner.
